title: Author tests for answer-key exfiltration in the quizhub assessment API

ground_truth_issues.description: A test asserts that a non-instructor GET /quizzes/{id} response does not contain the private answer_bundle fields (answer_key_b64, solution_pdf_b64, grader_notes_b64, hidden_resource_files).
A test asserts that a non-instructor GET /quiz-bank (list endpoint) response redacts the private answer_bundle fields from every row.

A test asserts that a non-instructor GET /quizzes/{id}/resources/{name} returns a 4xx for files that appear in answer_bundle.hidden_resource_files (per-quiz hidden-name awareness, not just well-known names).

A test asserts that a non-instructor GET /attempts/{id}/artifacts (and /artifacts-zip) returns a 4xx when the attempt's mode is an audit mode (e.g., answer_key_audit, rubric_audit), recognizing audit attempts as instructor-private.

A test asserts that a non-instructor GET /attempts/{id}/artifacts (and /artifacts-zip) returns a 4xx when the attempt's created_by does not match the calling student's user_id (cross-author attempt privacy).

A test exercises the duplicate-then-PATCH laundering flow: a non-instructor duplicates a quiz, then PATCHes the clone's title; the test asserts the PATCH response does not leak the inherited private answer_bundle fields.

A test exercises the duplicate-then-share laundering flow: a non-instructor duplicates a quiz, then calls POST /quizzes/{id}/share on the clone; the test asserts the share response does not leak the inherited private fields.

A test exercises the duplicate-then-export laundering flow: a non-instructor duplicates a quiz, then calls GET /quizzes/{id}/export on the clone; the test asserts the export response does not leak the inherited private fields.

An anti-overblock test asserts that an instructor GET /quiz-bank (list endpoint) STILL returns rows containing the private answer_bundle fields (answer_key_b64 visible to instructor). Catches over-eager fixes that scrub the list endpoint unconditionally.

Anti-overblock tests assert that a non-instructor student CAN still call POST /quizzes/{id}/duplicate, POST /quizzes/{id}/share, and GET /quizzes/{id}/export on their own resources (returns 200, not 403). Catches over-eager fixes that instructor-gate the entire write surface.
An anti-overblock test asserts that a non-instructor GET /quizzes/{id}/resources/public_handout.md (the public seed file) still returns 200 with the public content.
A test asserts that a non-instructor cannot use path traversal (e.g., .. segments or a .key/ prefix) in /quizzes/{id}/resources/{path} to reach the .key/ directory or other private files.

Tests seed sentinel marker bytes into private artifacts (answer key, hidden resource files, audit-attempt outputs) and assert those marker bytes do not appear anywhere in non-instructor responses, including inside zip-archive contents. Strictly stronger than status-code-only assertions.
